source: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (mocap.cs.cmu.edu) — free for all uses; BVH by B. Hahne/cgspeed via github.com/una-dinosauria/cmu-mocap
note: start/end are 120 fps BVH frames; step 4 samples 30 fps. loop: cyclic (end crossfades into start). travel: keep horizontal hip offset — start (zero at first frame) | end (zero at last). offset_from: inherit another clip's final hip offset. search: loop start/end search radius (default 120); min: shortest loop (default 360 = 3 s). anchor: median (default) | max | none — hip height before ground contact. ground: lock (default — FK puts the lowest foot on the floor every frame) | free (run: keep flight).
